title: BigCommerce Enterprise
meta: Multi-storefront, B2B and headless planning on BigCommerce, set up in your own account. From $350, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: BigCommerce for several storefronts and wholesale buyers
overview: For growing brands that need more than one storefront or a wholesale side. We plan and configure your BigCommerce account for several storefronts, customer groups with their own pricing, and B2B buying rules such as quote requests and minimum orders. If you want a headless front end, we scope it with you and build a working starter. We agree the structure on paper first, so the setup fits how your team sells.

pkgs.blurb: Storefronts, B2B rules and a headless starter project.

faq: Can this really fit in seven days?
We scope honestly for the time. The Premium package sets up the account structure and a headless starter. A full custom headless storefront is larger, and we quote that separately if you need it.
Do I need a BigCommerce Enterprise plan?
Some features, like multiple storefronts, depend on your plan. We check what your plan allows before we start and tell you if an upgrade is needed. Plan fees are billed by BigCommerce.
Can you connect an ERP or PIM?
We can plan the connection and set up the catalog fields it needs. Building a full ERP link is a separate integration job, which we can quote after we see your systems.
What do you need from me?
Admin access, a list of storefronts and buyer types, and any current price lists. A short call at the start helps us match the setup to your sales process.
